visualCharacteristics.structure: image | H3 + paragraphs + optional chevron link; rows stacked with spacing

contentPattern: One row per item, two cells. Image-first row: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = H3 + description paragraphs + optional link. Text-first row: cell 1 = text, cell 2 = image (image renders on the right). Mix the two to alternate. On mobile the image always stacks above the text. Empty paragraphs are dropped.
reuseGuidance: Use for horizontal teasers / text-image rows (photo beside a heading and copy). Use cards-feature for side-by-side tiles that wrap into a grid.
